p_units: fraction of each preprocessed frame range: .001,.001,.15,.105; percent equivalents .1,.1,15,10.5; user-requested ratio test
reconstruction_permission: user explicitly approved clearly labelled reconstructed inputs

balanced_rule.validation: first25% chronological frames; global unsupervised reference frozen from complete input
balanced_rule.normalization: minmax over legal positive validation candidates, component0 when range<=1e-12; raw metrics unchanged
balanced_rule.selection: within .01 of minimumJ prefer lower epsilon then lower actualtopology
balanced_rule.failure: NO epsilon0 fallback; repair illegality instead
balanced_rule.post_selection: freeze independently per dataset then rerun final Balanced cold pipeline

statistics: full-sequence main metrics; held-out75% NPE separately; historical results were previously observed, not a new blind test
ranking: Four displayed methods per dataset, no Base; SNS/TW/NPE numeric best/second; TD best/second within published and normalized-local unit groups; separate optimization and total time columns; TW coverage only in note

timing.validation_cache: allowed but excluded from cold timings

baseline_policy: quote SNS/TW/TD Table1; recompute NPE only
TD: sum adjacent matched final-anchor displacement / full fixed physical canvas extent, no percentage or temporal average
TW: paper k, valid only0<k<n/2; missing notzero
raster_fix: only if native independent rounding fails, solve closest legal integer skeleton at SAME L; continuous order,x,z,w unchanged; nearest anchors fixed where feasible; otherwise minimal joint rounding; validate rendered topology
